mechanism_narrative: The sharp collapse in TRANSIT (-21.3% at t-0w) signals a near-total cessation of commuting and public mobility. This sustained transit shock will suppress retail footfall for the next four weeks as consumers avoid transit-dependent shopping trips, driving RETAIL_REC further negative.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days exceeds the mean of the last 28 days, or TRANSIT recovers above -10% within two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating RESIDENTIAL mobility (+5.9% at t-0w, up from +1.0% at t-3w) indicates consumers sheltering in place. This behavioral shift reduces discretionary retail visits as households minimize non-essential outings, causing RETAIL_REC to remain depressed or decline further over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC recovers to within -5% of baseline while RESIDENTIAL remains above +5%, indicating shelter-in-place did not suppress retail.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above -10% within two weeks despite WORKPLACES remaining below -15%, indicating workplace closures did not suppress retail.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days exceeds the last 28-day mean, or either TRANSIT or WORKPLACES recovers above -10% within one week.
